observations: Reviewed native solo and co-op gameplay, powerup/door progression, guardian and terminal overlays.
Cyan P1 and orange P2 have separate labels, HP and dash bars; gentle separation prevents complete silhouette overlap. Player bolts have distinct colors.
Spawn warnings, hostile shots, original wizard/monster/key sprites and bottom objective text are readable at native resolution.
Both player-count replays reach the real YOU WIN overlay with independently owned scores; runtime reset starts a fresh match.
limitations: No physical cabinet or human enjoyment/balance study.
The two additions share a top-down shooter kit; they do not provide scrolling, melee or an RPG engine.
